blocks.text: INNNEW -Jakarta The Court of Water Sprinkling against ContraS activists, Jonah Andrie, was re-held in the Eastern Jakarta Military Court on Thursday (7 / 5 / 2026). In the trial, a psychologist from the Mades TNI Psychology Center revealed the psychological results of four members of the TNI who were accused in the matter.

The four defendants are second sergeant Edi Sudarko, First Lieutenant Buddha Haryanto Widhi, Captain Nandala Dwi Prasetyo, and first Lieutenant Sami Lakka. A psych eval was performed after the TNI Psychology Center received an official request from BAIS TNI on March 19, 2026. Colonel Arh Agus Shahrudin's psychologist explained that the examination aims to know the mental state and personality patterns of the defendants.

In his statement at the trial, Agus called the first defendant, Serda Edi Sudarko, has a proclivity for aggressive and dominant. It's also judged as less flexible in thinking and less impulsive when facing specific situations. Nevertheless, experts have confirmed that there is no major psychological disorder in the defendant's self. However, that personality pattern is rated to potentially trigger risky behavior.

Meanwhile, the second defendant, First Lieutenant Hadhi Haryanto Widhi, is called having low analytic capabilities so that it is judged undercooked in considering action. Experts also highlight the defendant's low self-control when facing certain pressures or concerns. The results were then made to be one of the considerations in the ongoing trial.

The heavy water-watering case of Andrie Jonah has previously become public concern after it was revealed that the accused were suspected of conducting the action due to offended by Andrie's criticism of TNI institutions. In the previous indictment, it was stated that the defendants judged Andrie's actions while criticizing the subject of the TNI Act as a form of harassment against military institutions.

The DA revealed the idea of sprinkling arose when the defendants gathered and discussed the upset thoughts of Andrie Jonah. One of the defendants is called to propose the use of rust-cleaning fluid to attack the victim. Such events later evolved into a violent water sprinkling act that caused Andrie to suffer serious injuries.

This case will still go on with the witness and other experts' agenda. The victim's legal power and a number of human rights workers are hoping that the process of law is transparent and is able to reveal all those involved in the case.
